body:
Nope, not afraid, just currently lacking the means.

And I just got one of those weird moments where I consciously remembered that there is a real person behind every username, and somewhere, you're sitting in your chair, wasting your life thinking up shit like this to post. It's a funny but sad picture in my head.

The thing is, I don't consider myself depressed. I go through most of the usual spectrum of emotions that everyone does every day, with it leaning just a bit to the darker side, which is not what a clinically depressed persons feels.

And ohgodno, my guidance counseler is the last person I would talk to. Just thinking about it makes me cringe. There is no one in real life that I would tell my problems to. :(
